theme_central: The reminder of the army of the elephant, annihilated by flocks of birds — recent historical proof of Allah's protection over the sacred House.
sources_note: Universally known content, no possible divergence.

branches.title: The people of the elephant
branches.resume: Your Lord rendered vain the scheme of the people of the elephant.

children.t: Scheme of the people of the elephant rendered vain by Allah

branches.title: Punishment by the birds
branches.resume: Flocks of birds (ababil) hurling stones of hardened clay, the army reduced to chewed-up straw.

children.t: Punishment by the ababil birds, army annihilated
